# algosec_ace_cloud_account_registration (Resource)

Owns a manual ACE cloud registration and its readable name/provider/account identity, only for unified-onboarding tenants. Requires experimental_ace_public_contracts and exclusive ownership. Typed write-only bootstrap inputs are submission-only, not desired access configuration; use replacement_version to deliberately resubmit. Replacement deletes registration before creating it; cannot use create_before_destroy for the same account. Delete removes ACE registration, never external IAM roles, applications, service accounts or keys. Import/refresh/name-only update/destroy work without bootstrap credentials. Complete inventory visibility required. No live acceptance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "aws_role_arn" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
variable "aws_external_id" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

# Manual registration/name only, not drift-managed access configuration.
# Bootstrap fields are submission-only. Write-only arguments require Terraform >= 1.11; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform >= 1.16.1.
resource "algosec_ace_cloud_account_registration" "aws" {
  cloud_provider      = "aws"
  account_id          = "123456789012"
  name                = "Example manual account"
  unified_onboarding  = true
  role_arn_wo         = var.aws_role_arn
  external_id_wo      = var.aws_external_id
  support_changes_wo  = false
  flow_logs_wo        = false
  replacement_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Expected cloud account ID, Azure subscription ID or GCP project ID. Verified from the accountKey-matched GET row, never parsed from accountKey. Changes replace.
- `cloud_provider` (String) aws, azure or gcp. Changes replace.
- `name` (String) Drift-managed registration display name. Updated using name-only PATCH.
- `unified_onboarding` (Boolean) Explicit assertion that the ACE tenant uses unified onboarding. Must be true. The API cannot detect historical-tenant eligibility before submission.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `application_id_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Azure service-principal application UUID; required despite optional schema wording to avoid omitted-credential ambiguity. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `application_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Azure service-principal secret. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `auth_provider_x509_cert_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) GCP auth provider certificate HTTPS URL. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `auth_uri_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) GCP OAuth authorization HTTPS URI. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `azure_tenant` (String) Required Azure tenant UUID, read from azureTenant. Omit for other providers. Changes replace.
- `client_email_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) GCP service-account email. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.

Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.

Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `credential_type_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) GCP credential type; explicitly service_account. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `external_id_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) AWS external ID. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `flow_logs_wo` (Boolean, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Nonsecret submission-only flow-log option, required explicitly for AWS creation/replacement. Not managed access drift. Omit for Azure/GCP.
- `organization_id` (String) Required GCP organization/folder identity, read from organizationId. Omit for other providers. Changes replace.
- `private_key_id_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) GCP private key ID. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.
- `replacement_version` (String) Nonsecret explicit trigger for delete/recreate with newly supplied bootstrap inputs. Bootstrap changes alone are submission-only and cannot be drift-detected.
- `role_arn_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) AWS role ARN matching account_id. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. - `support_changes_wo` (Boolean, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Nonsecret submission-only permission option, required explicitly for AWS/Azure creation/replacement. Not managed access drift. Omit for GCP.
- `token_uri_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) GCP OAuth token HTTPS URI. Write-only bootstrap input; required for the matching provider on creation/replacement. Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+; saved-plan ephemeral examples require Terraform 1.16.1+. Never drift-managed, persisted or reconstructed on import.

### Read-Only

- `auto_onboarded` (Boolean) Readable manual provenance. Only false can be owned or imported; automatic registrations are refused.
- `id` (String) Opaque accountKey returned by POST and matched exactly against GET. Import using the exact accountKey.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Use the exact accountKey from the complete ACE account inventory.
terraform import algosec_ace_cloud_account_registration.aws 'aws:123456789012'
```
